metadata.description: TerraLab for Claude: geodata for any place.

plugins.name: terralab
plugins.description: Geodata for any place, inside your agent: buildings, roads, addresses, boundaries, terrain, routes, travel-time areas and satellite images anywhere in the world, plus parcels and building heights in France. Each answer shows a map, names its source and licence, and gives files for any GIS tool: GeoPackage, Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML, CSV or GeoTIFF.
